description.text: The major has two specialties - English language and literature and English for information technology. It enjoys a good reputation for its excellent teaching. Ever since 1999, it has been improving itself, ranked the top in the state in the CEMT. The major is to professionals with both solid English and broad knowledge of science and culture who are expertise for the needs of 21st century era of the information and knowledge-based economy. Gradates are qualified for such positions as translation, teaching, management and research in foreign affairs, economy, trade, culture, the press, publishing, education, scientific research, tourism, and other sectors.

duration.text: The English at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.High school academic transcript 5.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: With senior high school diploma and HSK certificate of level 4 or above
